indicator_name: Environmental taxes by economic activity (BNS environmental-tax account): energy, transport, pollution, resource use, annual, million KZT
description: Экологические налоги по видам экономической деятельности (счёт экологических налогов БНС): энергоносители, транспорт, загрязнение, использование ресурсов, ежегодно, млн тенге
methodology: BNS «Экологические налоги по видам экономической деятельности» (stat.gov.kz element 478740, SEEA account; the file is in thousand KZT), calendar years 2016-2025, state budget plus National Fund, 19 ОКЭД sections by name + OTHER_PAYERS + ALL; item <GROUP>.<section>, GROUP = TOTAL, ENERGY, TRANSPORT, POLLUTION, RESOURCE. ONLY ENVIRONMENTAL TAXES in the SEEA sense, NOT all taxes: corporate income tax, VAT and payroll taxes are outside, and the file does not list the budget codes it covers. No ОКЭД divisions (05-09). Mining (TOTAL.B): 1 730 657 (2018), 928 306 (2020), 2 670 393 (2022), 2 724 431 (2024), 2 861 781 (2025) mln KZT -- 68 % of all environmental taxes in 2025 and about a third of the mining tax receipts implied by TAX_STRUCTURE_BY_INDUSTRY; in 2024 2 023 461 of it is energy taxes and 654 722 resource-use taxes. Checked on every sheet and year: sections add up to «Всего», the four groups to the total.
